description:
Convert a document file (base64-encoded bytes) to Markdown or text.

Dispatches on the filename extension. Supported: PDF, images (OCR),
spreadsheets (CSV, XLSX, XLSM, XLS, ODS), DOCX, PPTX, RTF, EPUB,
TXT, MD, HTML, JSON, XML.

filename.description: Original filename (its extension selects the converter).

name: convert_document
title: Convert Any Document to Markdown
